candidates.change_summary: Replace the safe addition and state update with an unchecked addition so overflow on balances[msg.sender] can wrap and change stored balance.

Move the log call before updating balances so if Log.AddMessage reverts or consumes gas differently, balances remains unchanged on revert; otherwise balances may differ due to reentrancy during logging.
Remove the overflow check require so a failing condition is no longer prevented and arithmetic wrap could alter balances after Deposit completes.
Skip updating the caller's own balance and instead increment a different address's balance (address(0)), causing balances at some key to differ from original after Deposit.
Replace the conditional that reverts when initialized with its negation so SetMinSum only allows setting when already initialized (inverts the if condition).
Remove the revert guard so SetMinSum always sets MinSum regardless of initialization state (delete the if check).
Change the assignment to add the provided value to MinSum instead of replacing it (MinSum += _val).
Change the assignment to subtract the provided value from MinSum (MinSum = MinSum - _val).
Change the assignment to set MinSum to a constant zero instead of the provided value.
